Turn Another Spare Phone into a Camera Device

By enabling Android\'s official Device Owner mode on a spare phone, Dedicated Device Mode delivers maximum monitoring reliability: 24/7 uninterrupted operation, auto-start on boot, and zero disruption from system sleep or notifications.
This phone is the viewer terminal and will NOT be reset or wiped in any way. All your photos, apps, and accounts remain completely intact.
📷 Spare Phone to be used as Camera: Requires Factory Reset
To grant official Android Device Owner privileges for 24/7 non-sleep monitoring, that spare phone must be factory reset. Please ensure you have backed up any needed files on that spare phone!
I understand this phone is safe and I have prepared another spare phone to reset

According to Android privacy and security policies, apps must be granted location permission to detect and read the currently connected Wi-Fi SSID.\n\nThis permission will strictly be used to auto-fill the Wi-Fi name and will NOT track or store your location data.
2 easy steps to get your free key:
① Tap the button below to log in (supports Google/Apple, select \"Personal\" for free use).
② Click \"Generate access token\" and paste the key (tskey-...) into the box below.
💡 Key FAQ & Expiry Info (Tap to Expand)
• Supports both API Key (recommended) or Auth Key.\n• The 90-day key lifetime is only for initial pairing; connected cameras stay connected permanently!
180-day key expiry has been permanently disabled for this camera!
Pick up the spare phone to be used as a camera.
Go to Settings > System > Reset options on that spare phone.
Select \"Erase all data (factory reset)\" and wait for the phone to restart.
🚨 Critical: DO NOT tap \"Start\" after reboot!
When the spare phone reboots to the \"Hello\" or \"Welcome\" screen, STAY ON THIS SCREEN and DO NOT tap Start! Tapping Start enters standard setup and prevents dedicated provisioning.
Spare phone is on Welcome screen, Next: Scan
【Step 1: Tap 6 Times】Tap rapidly 6 times on any blank space of the \"Hello / Welcome\" screen on the spare phone.
【Step 2: Connect Wi-Fi】If the spare phone prompts \"Wi-Fi connection needed to download barcode reader\", connect to Wi-Fi on the spare phone (official Android scanner download).
【Step 3: Scan QR Code】Once downloaded, the camera will open automatically. Aim it at the QR code below to scan.
📷 QR Code Ready: Aim Spare Phone to Scan
Once scanned, the spare phone will automatically download OcularNode & Tailscale, connect to your tailnet, and launch monitoring!

• Why does the spare phone ask to connect Wi-Fi after tapping 6 times?\nThis is standard Android behavior! After factory reset, the phone downloads the official Google QR scanning module over Wi-Fi in 3~5 seconds.
• Tapping 6 times has no response?\nMake sure to tap 6 times rapidly (2~3 taps per second) on the blank empty area above the \"Hello / Welcome\" text.

Enterprise WireGuard® zero-trust encryption, 100% free for personal use

Tailscale is an industry-leading enterprise mesh VPN powered by WireGuard®. It creates a direct, peer-to-peer (P2P) end-to-end encrypted tunnel between your own devices with zero third-party cloud relays—even Tailscale cannot view your video feeds. Stream securely from outside over cellular (4G/5G) without opening ports or public IPs!
